evidence.ACL: The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.
evidence.MCL: medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.
evidence.Medial OA: The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained with only mild chondral fraying.
evidence.Lateral OA: The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.
evidence.PF OA: Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates severe chondral fraying with some regions of focal cartilage loss seen to the lateral facet and apex of the patella.
evidence.Effusion: No significant knee effusion is detected.
evidence.Contusion: These changes are associated with subcortical cyst formation and edema seen to the patella involving lateral facet and apex.
